title: Testimony
description: Something one person wrote about another, published with the subject's consent and their author's name attached.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

author.description: The wallet, or the id under localIds, of whoever wrote it.

subject.description: The wallet, or the id under localIds, of whoever it is about.

detail.description: What was written, in the author's own words. A scene rather than an attribute: what the subject did, told by whoever was there.

signature.description: ed25519 over the record, hex. Signed by the author's wallet, so the words can be shown to have come from them.

state.description: Published only once the subject has agreed. Pending is written and not readable by anyone but its author.

sealedUntil.description: While set, the subject is told the record exists and not what it says. Opens when they write their own, or when this passes.
